raw_response: {"diagnosis": "From batch 3 onward the source delivers many POSTED transactions whose txn_ts is about 3 days before ingest_ts. The silver step's hard-coded 26-hour latency filter (ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26h) silently drops these valid, non-duplicate late arrivals (txn_id is unique across all 4802 rows), so silver and every gold table undercount. The fix keeps all POSTED transactions; the risk is that the 26-hour cutoff was a deliberate business rule, so its owner should confirm.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.62, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
